name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires that the agent holds the box when it reaches the exit. The current clauses only guarantee that the agent ever holds the box, not that it holds it at exit, so the agent could reach the exit without the box and still satisfy the clauses. Add a hard rule that enforces holding the box on the exit step, e.g. `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` (hard). Optionally drop the redundant `Existence(holding_box)` clause, because the new rule already implies the box is held at least once. This will correctly capture "Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again."

texts: Reach the exit at least once.
When at the exit, hold the box.
After the box falls, hold the box.
